prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 21px · one-line width 61px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 64px · one-line width 768px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 1057px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 437px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 436px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按成员汇总第 34 周的工作状态、本周完成情况和下周计划，帮助团队识别进展、风险与阻塞。","reading":"读者先按行找到成员和状态，再横向阅读完成情况与计划；也会纵向扫描状态，比较不同成员的进展。长文本将决定行高，较短单元格可在同一行内留白。","groups":["「成员」与「状态」共同构成每行的身份和状态索引，应便于快速扫描。","「本周完成」与「下周计划」分别描述过去与未来的工作，角色相近，需要保留足够空间供连续阅读和比较。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名","状态图标与文字","数字、英文缩写及其他不可断开的标识"],"may_wrap":["本周完成的中文叙述可自然换行。","下周计划的中文叙述可自然换行；较短的完成情况可利用计划产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [74, 82, 130, 150] · table 437×1383px · row heights [39, 250, 224, 250, 197, 224, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [74, 82, 120, 160] · table 437×1436px · row heights [39, 224, 276, 224, 250, 197, 224] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [74, 82, 135, 145] · table 437×1409px · row heights [39, 250, 250, 250, 197, 224, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"成员姓名、状态图标与文字均保持完整，便于先定位成员再横向阅读；两列叙述的宽度关系也反映了计划内容较长。四个表头均未换行。","problems":"计划列在多行中形成较窄的文字块，部分长计划把行高拉大，完成列下方留下明显空白；但整体行高仍是三版中最紧凑的。","cause":"成员列 74px、状态列 82px 恰好容纳单行内容；完成列 130px 和计划列 150px 的可用文字宽度分别只有 109px 和 129px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"160px 的计划列让多处计划叙述更连贯，陈嘉禾和赵一鸣的计划比 r1A 更少换行；身份与状态仍易于扫描。","problems":"完成列明显偏窄，林思远和吴桐的完成情况被切成许多短行并主导行高，右侧相对较短的计划下方出现较大空白；全表也变得更长。","cause":"从完成列转移 10px 给计划列后，完成列仅 120px、文字区仅 99px，部分单元格因此增加多行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"135px 的完成列改善了部分句子的连续性，尤其是吴桐一行；姓名、状态和表头仍保持完整。","problems":"计划列略窄，林思远的计划比 r1A 多占一行；陈嘉禾和赵一鸣的长计划仍主导行高，使完成列下方留白。整体高度略高于 r1A。","cause":"相较 r1A，完成列增加 5px，而更长的计划列减少到 145px，部分计划文本跨过换行阈值。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"plan-155","widths":[74,82,125,155],"change":"以 r1A 为基准，给计划列再增加 5px，观察能否减少长计划行数，同时避免 r1B 中完成列过窄的问题。"},{"name":"compact-index","widths":[74,81,135,146],"change":"状态列按 61px 单行内容加 21px 边界的事实不能再缩减，因此保留 82px；改用 74、82、134、146，在两列叙述间测试接近 r1C 的另一处换行阈值。"},{"name":"balanced-text","widths":[74,82,140,140],"change":"让完成与计划列等宽，测试完成列获得更多空间后能否降低由完成情况主导的行高，并观察计划列变窄带来的代价。"}]}
